Very rare and high standard penthouse located in the "main street". This luxurious apartment is one of few apartments with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms!
The apartment is located in the middle of the city center. All restaurants and shops are literally right outside your window. Fully equipped with everything you need. Towels and bedlinen is of course included during the entire stay. Guests say the location is perfect!

WELCOME :)

The space
About your host: 
This apartment is managed by Arctic Homes. Leading rental company in Tromsø with 10+ years of experience. We have over 450+ reviews on Airbnb alone, with an average score of 4.83 (per 01.09.25)

This apartment can fit 7 people. One of few apartments with 2 bathrooms. 
The apartment has got 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. 
Bedroom 1: Double bed + bathroom
Bedroom 2: Double bed
Bedroom 3: Double bed
Living room: Extra bed available

Please note, we use a professional cleaning company before and after every stay. This is very important for us and we know that this is also very important for our guests. 

*Professional cleaning, before and after your stay. Always!
*Professionally cleaned towels and bedding. 
*24 hour check in. 
*10% DISCOUNT on some of the best restaurants in town. 
*A fully equipped apartment with amenities such as TV, Wi-Fi, washer, hair dryer, fully equipped kitchen, regular oven, fridge, freezer, TV, cleaning equipment, soap, and toilet paper. 
*Descriptions for nearest stores and transportation options. 
*Business ready requirements met. 
*Safe area requirements. 
* Professional company with many years on experience
*Public parking available nearby!

Other things to note
Practical information:
✦ Keys are located in keybox. Code will be given upon arrival

✦ Check-in AFTER 16:00 (4PM)
✦ Check-out BEFORE 11:00 (11AM)

✦ Put the dirty dishes in the dishwasher and start the dishwasher before you go.
✦ Throw all the trash and food in the trash bin for your check-out day.

Amazing stay in Tromsø! The place was absolutely perfect, clean, cozy, and in a great location with everything you need.
But what truly made the experience exceptional was the host. Honestly one of the best I’ve ever dealt with super friendly, responsive, and genuinely caring. He made everything smooth from check-in to check-out and went above and beyond to ensure we had a great time.
Highly recommended, and I would definitely stay here again!
